title: Configuration Proposal, Compatibility, Blueprint & Interchange Adapters
objective: Implement engineering-specific configuration proposals/diffs, compatibility/interface/adapter/substitution evaluation, saved blueprint/preset/loadout-role references and engineering-domain interchange adapters over Packet-07 and ARI/PCA common infrastructure without creating a second Asset, compatibility, review, version or publication authority.
acceptance: Configuration proposals remain noncanonical until separately authorized owner commit.
Install/remove/substitute proposals pin target Asset identity and owner versions and revalidate before any future commit handoff.
Compatibility is explicit and definition-driven; name/visual similarity never creates compatibility.
Unknown or conflicting compatibility remains unresolved and fails closed where compatibility is required.
Explicit governed adapter/substitution rules may permit a candidate only within their declared scope.
Saved blueprints/presets cannot bypass target-specific owner/version/permission/compatibility revalidation.
Engineering import/export preserves ARI identity, rights, provenance, version and explicit lossy/unsupported semantics.
Optional AI may suggest but has no commit, compatibility, publication or owner-mutation authority.
Packet-07 retains generic proposal/preview/dry-run/commit/review semantics and ARI/PCA retains generic provenance/version/review/import-export authority.
boundaries: MERA-01 remains the workspace/topology/authority predecessor and is not reopened.
D17/PPIA-03 and MIB-14/PPIA-04 retain live Asset/configuration authority.
At MERA-03 closeout the roadmap DAG must be reconsulted because MBES-01 rotation becomes eligible when MERA-03 and already-completed MRCS-14 are both satisfied.
cross_program_rotation_after_completion: MBES-01 eligible when MERA-03 + MRCS-14 are completed; DAG takes precedence over local strict successor.
next_action: MERA-03 is completed_verified. Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation shows the MBES-01 rotation milestone is satisfied, but MBES remains blocked by hard_requires MERA and backlog activation_after MERA-24. MERA-05 is therefore selected_not_started.
